name: My Girlfriend & My Futa Grandma 2
source:
Following immediately after the events of Futa Grandma 1 watch now as the girlfriend of our happy couple got to the boyfriends mothers house safely, but because he slept in before the storm he's stuck at Grandma's! Oh yes, it's Mum's turn now! But don't worry, she'll happily give video calls and texts to let her son know how well looked after his girlfriend is.

[From F95Zone]
